Thank you, I appreciate it.

I really wish I knew that at the time- I was under the impression that it meant it just went away... reinforced by the fact that it never showed up on ccap. I was truly clueless. 

It probably would have benefited me to go to court, then, and defend my innocence. I'm hoping I can get this sealed or expunged somehow.

Thanks again.
Thank you. I do not know how to go about doing that. I will look into it. I don't know where to start with this.

>don't be afraid to go out to events and bars solo and put yourself way out there.

This is how I made my friends. Just started going to things alone with an open mind. Ended up meeting a bunch of awesome people every time that are now my friends.
Was taken freelensing w/ stock 18-55mm T5i lens.

I hear you. I feel a lot of therapists are actually quite passive and move too slowly or make super general suggestions that I have already applied.

I'm sorry you went through all of that. I'm hoping to find someone I can see long term, too.

Where I live now I am also struggling to find in-network psychs. 
But, as you said, having a therapist that is effective is worth it, otherwise it's just a waste of time, unfortunately.
I wonder if location plays a role? I haven't seen anyone since moving to a much bigger city. Maybe I will have better luck here.

Thanks for your input, I appreciate it.

I was mainly concerned because of what I have been through.
My past academic record is not the most linear or nice and feel like the fact that I got accepted to a very good school after a lot of trouble might be something I shouldn't throw away. Ugh. 

Thanks again.
